quotes.text: The ability to edit finalized subscription invoices is in preview.

Set [payment_settings.save_default_payment_method](https://docs.stripe.com/api/subscriptions/object.md#subscription_object-payment_settings-save_default_payment_method) to `on_subscription` to save the payment method from a successful subscription payment as `subscription.default_payment_method`. The setting defaults to `off`.
The subscription’s status must be `active`, `past_due`, or `trialing`. It can’t be `unpaid` or ended.

old_evidence.text: If your integration uses [customer-configured Accounts](https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/accounts/create.md#v2_create_accounts-configuration-customer), replace `Customer` and event references in the code examples with the equivalent Accounts v2 API references.

findings: At the same canonical URL, the 2026-11-07 capture retains the core first-invoice, renewal, pending-item, void, and metadata rules from the 2026-05-13 capture (new lines 15-30, 44-56, 239-249, 284-315; old lines 16-45, 208-220, 255-286). The existing source summarizes those rules at lines 15-92, so replacement of their dated evidence is unnecessary.

New raw lines 62-69 preserve four ordered fallback positions for the first available saved default payment method and extend position 3 to customer-configured Account objects. This fallback is a different dimension from which payment method types invoices may accept: new line 71 explicitly separates subscription payment_method_types. New lines 73-77 add an opt-in on_subscription rule after a successful subscription payment, default off, distinct from the Dashboard customer-saving setting.

New Dashboard payment-update-link instructions and restrictions appear at lines 79-98. The link changes only the associated automatically billed subscription, requires active/past_due/trialing, accepts a card, is single-use, and expires unused after 30 days; it does not change the customer default. Related historical source and concept already cover many restrictions, but the current invoice source does not route them.

New retrieval guidance at lines 125-143 distinguishes expansion through parent.subscription_details.subscription on API version 2025-03-31.basil or later from expansion through subscription before that version. Do not present the new path without the version boundary.

The edit-finalized-invoice heading is qualified as preview at lines 32-42. It does not repeal the ordinary finalized-invoice amount-edit restriction at line 30 or establish account eligibility. A source update should present the preview as a qualified exception, without treating its registration example as an operation to execute.

Examples changed from Node SDK to curl at old lines 88-115, 152-167 and 181-204 versus new lines 145-162, 199-208 and 222-235; described invoice item behavior stayed materially the same. Heading spacing, italic syntax, numbered-list formatting, Hosted Invoice Page capitalization, and a corrected metadata API URL are presentational or navigation changes (diff lines 103-120, 215-275, 279-360).
substantive_changes: Preview-only finalized subscription invoice editing is newly documented, while ordinary post-finalization amount edits remain restricted (new 30-42).
Payment fallback position 3 now explicitly includes customer-configured Account objects, and saving a successful payment as subscription default is opt-in with off default (new 62-77).
Dashboard payment-update-link behavior and eligibility are added to this captured page (new 79-98).
Invoice retrieval expansion is newly split by the 2025-03-31.basil API version boundary (new 125-143).
historical_claims_to_preserve: Keep the 2026-05-13 Accounts v2 instruction as dated evidence from old line 8; its omission from the new capture is not deprecation. The new capture independently includes the Account default-payment-method field at line 68, but does not restate the broader Customer/event-reference instruction.
Keep old Node SDK examples dated to the 2026-05-13 variant (old 88-115, 152-167, 181-204); the 2026-11-07 curl rendering is not evidence that the SDK calls were removed or deprecated.

Preserve existing first/renewal lifecycle, flexible metered-only exception, pending-item cancellation and tax caveats, void-state outcomes, and metadata-time distinctions with their original capture provenance (old 16-45, 208-232, 255-286; new 15-56, 237-261, 284-315).
conflicts: wiki/sources/source-stripe-subscriptions-payment-methods-setting.md:29-37 uses a Payment method priority heading for payment_settings.payment_method_types and says either the Dashboard invoice setting or subscription save_default_payment_method makes any method used to pay the new subscription default. The historical raw for that setting, lines 32-40, concerns allowed payment method types and its then-current saving explanation; it is not a competing four-level saved-default fallback chain. New invoice raw lines 62-71 distinguish saved-default fallback from allowed types, while lines 73-77 specify a successful subscription payment, opt-in on_subscription with default off, and a separate Dashboard Save customer payment information setting. Reconcile the saving claim and label each priority dimension accurately.

wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions-invoices.md:95 calls the invoice metadata snapshot immutable, while the new raw line 309 says it contains subscription metadata at creation even if later modified; retain the supported snapshot semantics without expanding to an unsupported blanket immutability claim. The concept's payment setting summary at lines 109-111 omits the off default and successful-payment condition from new line 75.

wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions-invoices.md:54 says setting auto_advance=false for review prevents auto-finalization. Both old raw lines 234-242 and new raw lines 263-271 explicitly describe preventing automatic payment attempts and invoice emailing, then resuming automatic collection; neither passage expressly establishes the finalization outcome. Correct the concept's overbroad finalization claim or qualify it with separate authority. wiki/sources/source-stripe-subscriptions-invoices.md:46 merely says to set auto_advance=false and later resume, and is not the source of that claim.
unresolved_questions: The preview-registration paragraph does not establish which accounts are eligible or what revision operations a registered account can perform beyond the preview label (new 32-42).

The captured page does not establish that the broader Accounts v2 Customer/event-reference mapping in the old variant was withdrawn; verify with dedicated Accounts v2 authority before changing that historical guidance (old 8; new 68).
No captured text proves actual invoice payment, bank receipt, customer eligibility for payment links, or execution of any example in an account.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/billing/invoices/subscription, the November capture describes immediate first-invoice finalization for charge_automatically, roughly one-hour finalization for send_invoice, a draft renewal window, conditional paid/active outcomes, and the flexible metered-only creation exception (new lines 15-56). Its four-level order selects the first available saved default payment method, while payment_method_types separately controls accepted types (new lines 62-71). The matched May capture carries the core lifecycle and Customer v1 fallback (old lines 16-58), already summarized in [[source-stripe-subscriptions-invoices]]. The new page adds preview-qualified editing, Account v2 position 3, opt-in successful-payment saving, Dashboard link limits, and versioned retrieval expansion (new lines 32-42, 68-98, 125-143).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/billing/invoices/subscription, substantive additions are preview-only finalized-invoice editing, customer-configured Account default fallback at position 3, saving the method used in a successful subscription payment only when on_subscription is set (default off), restricted card update links, and API-version-specific invoice expansion (new lines 32-42, 62-98, 125-143). Payment method types control accepted types and are not another saved-default fallback order (new line 71; historical payment-methods-setting raw lines 32-40). Node-to-curl examples are presentation, not SDK deprecation (old lines 88-115, 152-167; new lines 145-162, 199-208). [[source-stripe-subscriptions-invoices]] needs qualified additions. The overbroad auto-finalization claim is in wiki/concepts/stripe-subscriptions-invoices.md:54; the source at line 46 merely describes pause and resume, while old lines 234-242 and new lines 263-271 expressly address automatic payment attempts and emailing.
